texts.fd_email_format: Andika aderesi ya imeli nka name@example.com.
texts.fd_email_throwaway: Iyi aderesi ya imeli imara igihe gito gusa. Koresha aderesi ugumana.
texts.fd_go_online: Jya kuri interineti, hanyuma wongere ugerageze.
texts.fd_long: Nimero zo muri {country} zigira imibare {n}. Imibare irenze ntiyongerwamo.
texts.fd_match_retry: Saba nimero nshya ku kindi gikoresho, hanyuma wongere ugerageze.
texts.fd_our_side: Hari ikibazo cyabaye ku ruhande rwacu. Si amakosa yawe.
texts.fd_owner_plan: Nyir'ubucuruzi ashobora guhitamo gahunda nini muri Gahunda n'imipaka.
texts.fd_short: Iyi nimero ni ngufi cyane. Nimero zo muri {country} zigira imibare {n}.
texts.fd_use_code: Fungura ihuza cyangwa wandike kode iri mu butumire bwawe.
texts.fd_use_ticket: Koresha itike usanzwe ufite, cyangwa ubanze uve muri uwo murongo.
